'''Jurvi''' was one of the many [[sargheet]] farmers who suffered through the economic hard times that befell the planet [[Dagro]], during the height of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
His friend, [[Kirlan Swens]], asked him to be part of a farm "chain" that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] could use to reach [[Vale City]] without being spotted, when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] was on Dagro to investigate the possibility of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base on the planet, some two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]. He was one of the farmers who helped Obi-Wan and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], locate and destroy the last [[crawl-carrier]] before it could eliminate a village.
